class_name: 起点-極端例-カラシテ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Picks out the most basic or first-noticed detail and invites you to extrapolate: if even that much is so, the whole is (看板からして怪しい, 玄関の生け花からして違う). It attaches straight to a noun, and the predicate is an evaluation, critical as often as admiring. The same surface also serves as the adverbial variant of the inferential からすると family; this lane exemplifies rather than reasons from evidence to a guess.

examples.ruby: あの店[みせ]は看板[かんばん]からして怪[あや]しい。
examples.english: That place looks dodgy starting with the sign out front.

examples.ruby: この映画[えいが]はタイトルからして意味[いみ]が分[わ]からない。
examples.english: With this film, even the title makes no sense, and it goes downhill from there.

examples.ruby: あの旅館[りょかん]は玄関[げんかん]の生[い]け花[ばな]からして違[ちが]う。
examples.english: That inn is on another level, starting with the flower arrangement in the entryway.
